units.source_text: 式部卿亲王等候女儿回家，心中非常懊恼。

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo waited for his daughter to come home, deeply vexed at heart.

units.source_text: 老夫人边哭边骂：“你把太政大臣当作好亲戚，我看是你的七世冤家！

en.t: The old lady wept as she scolded him: "You think the Chancellor is a fine relative, but to my mind he is your enemy through seven lives!

units.source_text: 以前我们的女儿欲入宫当女御，他曾多方阻挠，使得我们难堪。

en.t: When our daughter once wished to enter the palace as an imperial consort, he obstructed her in every possible way and humiliated us.

units.source_text: 你说是他流放须磨时你不曾同情于他，他怀恨未解之故。

en.t: You say it is because he still bears a grudge that you showed him no sympathy when he was exiled to Suma.

units.source_text: 世人也都如此议论。

en.t: People everywhere are saying the same thing.

units.source_text: 然而亲戚之间岂可如此！

en.t: But how can relatives behave this way toward one another!

units.source_text: 凡宠爱妻子，必有余惠及于妻子的家族。

en.t: Whenever a man cherishes his wife, some of that favor ought naturally to extend to her family.

units.source_text: 源氏大人却只爱紫姬一人，不顾其他。

en.t: Lord Genji, however, loves only Lady Murasaki and pays no mind to anyone else.

units.source_text: 况且年纪这么大了，还要弄一个来历不明的女子来，当作义女抚养。

en.t: And at his age, he still brings in some woman of unknown background and raises her as an adopted daughter.

units.source_text: 自己玩得厌了，想把她配给一个忠实可靠、不会变心的人，就拉了我们的女婿去，百般奉承他。

en.t: Once he has tired of amusing himself with her, he decides to match her with someone loyal, dependable, and unlikely to change his heart, so he draws in our son-in-law and flatters him in every possible way.

units.source_text: 此种行径，安得不叫人气死！”

en.t: How could conduct like that fail to make a person die of anger!"

units.source_text: 她大声痛骂不休。

en.t: She went on loudly denouncing him without end.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王答道：“哎呀，你的话多难听！

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo answered, "Good heavens, how unpleasant your words are!

units.source_text: 切勿信口乱骂世人无可非难的大臣！

en.t: You must not carelessly revile a minister whom the world has no cause to blame!

units.source_text: 他是贤明之人，一定先加考虑，然后做此报复。

en.t: He is a wise man, and surely considered the matter carefully before carrying out this retaliation.

units.source_text: 我被算在内，乃我自身之不幸。

en.t: That I was counted among those affected is my own misfortune.

units.source_text: 他装作若无其事，而为须磨谪居之事对人做种种报复，或使之升，或使之沉，都很贤明公正。

en.t: He acts as though nothing is amiss, yet he repays people in various ways for what happened during his exile at Suma, raising some and lowering others, and in all of it he is wise and just.

units.source_text: 只有我一人，因有姻亲之谊，所以前年我五十寿辰，他的祝仪特别隆重，举世盛称，使我家当受不起。

en.t: Only in my case, because of our bond by marriage, he made the gifts for my fiftieth birthday the year before last especially grand; the whole world praised them, and my household could hardly bear such honor.

units.source_text: 我常引为一生无上之荣幸，不敢再有奢望了。”

en.t: I have always regarded it as the supreme honor of my life, and I would not dare hope for anything more."

units.source_text: 老夫人听了这话，越发生气了，使尽恶语，把源氏乱骂一顿。

en.t: When the old lady heard this, she grew even angrier and exhausted every insult in a furious tirade against Genji.

units.source_text: 这老夫人真是个不良之人。

en.t: This old lady was truly a person of poor character.
